import re


def fix_romanian(text: str) -> str:
    mapping = {
        "Ş": "Ș",
        "ş": "ș",
        "Ţ": "Ț",
        "ţ": "ț",
        "S\u0327": "Ș",
        "s\u0327": "ș",
        "T\u0327": "Ț",
        "t\u0327": "ț",
    }
    pattern = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(k) for k in mapping))
